interpretations: Join telescopes to observatories on `observstation` using an inner join, and group the matched telescopes by `lunarstage`, with NULL as a separate group. For each group, count all telescopes and average non-NULL `bandusagepct` values. Compute the unweighted mean of the non-NULL group averages, retain groups whose average exceeds it, and return one unrounded row containing the unweighted mean of the retained group averages, the sum of their telescope counts, and their mean excess over the overall mean
queries:
WITH lunar_groups AS (
    SELECT o.lunarstage,
           COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
           AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
    FROM telescopes AS t
    INNER JOIN observatories AS o
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_mean
    FROM lunar_groups
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_bandusage) AS retained_mean,
       SUM(g.telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
       AVG(g.avg_bandusage - o.overall_mean) AS mean_excess
FROM lunar_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE g.avg_bandusage > o.overall_mean
